text: dsh-genoffice-captain 是供 DSH Web 和 Desktop 使用的 GenOffice 任务列表插件：当用户消息提及任务列表技能或 agent 加载相关技能时，它检测触发并通知浏览器端。仅有一个活跃会话时直接启动本机 GenOffice；存在多个活跃会话时显示指定 Captain 面板，可选择负责协调的会话、为其加星并排除旧的 Captain，也可选择不编排直接启动。插件还会将随附技能复制到 DSH skills 目录（已有目录不会覆盖）。适合在多个 DSH 会话协同处理 GenOffice 任务列表时选择协调会话。使用前需在本机安装 GenOffice。

dsh-genoffice-captain helps DSH Web and Desktop start GenOffice for task-list work. It detects skill triggers, launches the app for a solo session, or opens a pane to choose a Captain when several sessions are active. Users can also skip orchestration. GenOffice must be installed locally.
想在 DSH 里提到任务列表技能时自动打开 GenOffice。
多个会话一起做表格任务时，怎么选一个负责协调的会话？
Can I launch the task-list app directly when I only have one active session?
dsh-genoffice-captain 的功能「指定 Captain」：任务列表触发时若有多个活跃会话，会打开选择面板。用户选中会话后，插件为其加星、移除旧 Captain 的星标、排入协调提示并启动 GenOffice。
dsh-genoffice-captain 的功能「单会话启动」：任务列表触发时若只有一个活跃会话，插件会直接请求启动本机 GenOffice；用户也可在面板打开“不编排”选项，记住该会话的选择并直接启动。

dsh-genoffice-captain README · dsh-genoffice-captain：A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin for GenOffice task lists. When a session invokes `GenOffice_XLSX_Tasklist` or `/GenOfficeXLSXTasklistOrchestration`, it launches GenOffice straight away for solo work, or first opens a **DESIGNATE THE CAPTAIN ⭐** pane so you can choose which session orchestrates.

dsh-genoffice-captain README · What it does：- **Trigger.** A message you send that names either skill (`GenOffice_XLSX_Tasklist`, `/GenOfficeXLSXTasklistOrchestration`, or the DSH names `/genoffice-xlsx-tasklist` and `/genoffice-xlsx-tasklist-orchestration`), or the agent loading either skill with the `skill` tool.
- **One active session:** GenOffice is launched (or brought forward) and nothing else happens.
- **Several active sessions:** a pane opens over the right quarter of the window (the session sidebar on the left stays visible) with the header DESIGNATE THE CAPTAIN ⭐, a **No Orchestration** switch and a dropdown of the open and active sessions, listed by session name and age (● running, ○ idle; running or used in the last 6 hours, sub-agents excluded). A session without a title yet shows as `Untitled session <id>`; its working folder appears only as the tooltip.
  - Flip **No Orchestration** and GenOffice launches with no Captain. The choice is remembered for that session, so its later triggers launch GenOffice directly.
  - **Designate ⭐** renames the chosen session to `⭐ <title>` (`⭐ Captain` if it has no title yet), takes the star off any previous Captain, queues a messag

dsh-genoffice-captain README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness with DSH Web or DSH Desktop. Tested with DSH Desktop 2.0.13 (dsh 0.1.5-rc.2) and DSH Web (dsh 0.1.5-rc.3) on macOS.
- [GenOffice](https://github.com/genspark-ai/genoffice) on macOS (`/Applications/GenOffice.app`), Windows (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\GenOffice\GenOffice.exe`) or Linux (`/opt/GenOffice/genoffice`, `/usr/bin/genoffice`, `/usr/local/bin/genoffice`, `~/Applications/GenOffice.AppImage`). Set `GENOFFICE_PATH` for any other location.
- The two skills ship inside the plugin. The pane lists what it found.

dsh-genoffice-captain README · Install：DSH Web or any CLI profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:rajpaulsingh6-stack/dsh-genoffice-captain
```

DSH Desktop (its profile is managed by the app, so add the package in the profile folder and list it as a bundle, then restart DSH Desktop):

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
pnpm add github:rajpaulsingh6-stack/dsh-genoffice-captain

dsh-genoffice-captain README · then add "dsh-genoffice-captain" to dsh.profile.bundles in package.json：```

The plugin is plain JavaScript with no dependencies and no build step, so a GitHub install needs no build permission.

text: dsh-genoffice-captain README · Security：The plugin's routes (`/api/genoffice-captain/*`) answer loopback requests only, and launching needs a POST with a custom header, so other web pages cannot trigger it. It only ever starts the GenOffice app; it never runs text from a message.
